column2: Opens a link to an extradimensional space that only the caster can access. If cast inside the pocket plane, it will return the caster to the original map, at the same position it departed when entering the pocket plane.
Attack a target with a prehensile tentacle, grappling it and immobilizing it for a short time.
Launch a luminous flesh bulb that acts as a disruptor flare.
Absorb a flesh beast, destroying it and empowering the caster for a short while, as well as healing some of their wounds.
Causes a torrent of pressurized acid to be expelled out of all of this person's pores, creating an acidic explosion that will hurt everyone nearby. It will not affect the caster.
Vents the heated gasses produced by this person's internal processes. This creates a wave of superheated air that will affect the surrounding tiles. It will not affect the caster.
Remotely hacks the IFF sensors of a mechanoid to temporarily swap its allegiance. This will last for a day, after which the mechanoid will revert to its former allegiance and attack indiscriminately.

Psychically create a feedback loop in a mech's connection, overloading its bandwidth and causing it to explode, destroying itself. This explosion will damage anything nearby, with the explosion range depending on the mech's bandwidth.
Summon a temporary band node that will increase the caster's bandwidth by 10 for a whole week.
Summon a Militor mechanoid. It will be part of the colony for a period of 1 day, vanishing afterwards. The carrier will need at least 1 mech bandwidth to use this ability.
Summon a Tesseron mechanoid. It will be part of the colony for a period of 1 day, vanishing afterwards. The carrier will need at least 3 mech bandwidth to use this ability.
Summon a Centipede Blaster mechanoid. It will be part of the colony for a period of 1 day, vanishing afterwards. The carrier will need at least 4 mech bandwidth to use this ability.
Consumes minerals to harden the users body against piercing and sharp attacks.
Drains minerals to increase the work efficiency of the user.
Use the stored minerals to shoot a concentrated lump of soil. This will cause blunt trauma in the target.
Flap wings to jump a short distance.
Forces an unstable mutation on the caster's body. This mutation will activate a new random gene for 12 hours. After that period passes, the gene will deactivate.
Secretes a cloud of pheromonal compounds that are irresistible to all insects. They'll feel re-invigorated and strengthened when close to the carrier.

Psychically blast the minds of other people, causing mental instability that makes them more prone to mental breaks, and greatly increases their psychic sensitivity. This effects lasts for three hours and can be used on both hostile and friendly targets.

Devour the brain of an incapacitated but living person, absorbing part of their intellect and gaining a buff that depends on the highest skill of the devoured brain. This obviously kills the target.\n\nOnly one "devour" buff can be active at a time. Using the ability before the 2 day timer refreshes the buff and its duration.
Forcefully extract a gene from an incapacitated but living person, incorporating it into the caster's xenotype as a xenogene. The gene is chosen at random. This will kill the target.
Attack a target with a prehensile tail, grappling it and immobilizing it for a short time.
Heals all non-permanent injuries, but ages the user 7 years with each use. If the user ages themselves with this ability beyond their lifespan, they die.
Removes a random trait, and adds a new, random one.
Removes five random traits, and adds five new, random ones.

Caster will absorb a negative memory from a target, capping out at -40.\n\nAbility works on memories, which are thoughts that expire after time. Situational thoughts, such as "being in terrible pain" won't work.
Makes the caster move faster for a short while.
Summons an ocular slinger under the control of the caster. This animal is a permanent colony animal, and can be drafted. A new scorpion can be summoned if the previous one is killed.
Psychically causes the vitreous humour inside the target's eyes to heat to a boiling point, destroying them and leaving the poor victim forever blind.
Converts flora in an area into ocular versions.
Converts flora in an area into ocular versions.

Destroys the pocket plane, along with everything inside it. WARNING: you can open a new pocket plane, but the original will be forever lost.
Transfers items to pocket plane. Items can be transported to a pocket plane, but cannot be taken out of it!
Accumulate energy and release it in a powerful electric jolt that electrocutes its target..
Spew flammable bile generated by a special organ in the neck. The bile ignites immediately in contact with oxygen, creating a dangerous conflagration that will set everything on its path on fire.

Regurgitate specially strong stomach acids, spraying a wide area with their contents. These acids will cause horrific wounds that get progressively worse as the acid burns through the underlying tissues.
Direct a dangerous gaze that has the ability to turn the victim into stone. Something something mechanites, or something. Look, it's science.
Produce strands of sticky silk on the wrists, and throw these webs at will, stunning enemies.
Psychically blast the mind of other people, causing them to go berserk and attack everyone around them indiscriminately. This ability can be resisted by targets with low psychic sensitivity.
Spew large amounts of a sterilizing liquid. This destroys Blight on plants, as well as causing an increase in immunity gain rate at the expense of fertility.
Causes affected targets to be struck with fear, reducing their attack accuracy and defense for a short duration.
Spew large amounts of a cryogenic fluid. This liquid freezes everything it touches, causing frostburn and hypothermia.
Exhale a cloud of toxic fumes that engulfs enemies in a suffocating miasma. The foul stench forces affected targets to vomit uncontrollably.
Psychically shift skin tones to camouflage in almost any surroundings.
Teleport to a desired position not too far from the starting point.
Implant this person's xenogenes into any subject using a disgusting injector stinger.\n\nWhen implanted, a xenogerm will overwrite the target's xenogenes. Germline genes will be unaffected.
Implant this person's endogenes into any subject using a disgusting injector stinger.\n\nWhen implanted, a germline will overwrite the target's endogenes. Xenogenes will be unaffected.

Repurposes existing tumors to provide a huge boost to movement and working speed.
Repurposes existing tumors to provide a huge boost to their immune system, and overall stamina.
Repurposes existing tumors to heal other people, consuming the cancerous masses in the process.
Transfers existing tumors to other people, which is generally as painful and dangerous as it sounds. Can be used as an offenssive tool or as a way to transfer tumors to other colonists.
A loose union of townships established by genetically modified humans of all kinds. This group is generally friendly towards outsiders.

A loose confederation of pirate gangs established by genetically modified humans of all kinds.

They have little interest in building, or farming, preferring to take their sustenance from others using violence.

Their technology level depends mostly on who they've managed to steal from recently. Mostly they carry gunpowder weapons, though some prefer to stab victims at close range.

Carriers of this gene can activate their mineral reserves to harden their skin against sharp and piercing attacks. To keep this armour active consumes minerals both passively and whenever hit by an attack. The strength of this resistance is based on the mineral reserve of the carrier.
Carriers of this gene can use the stored minerals to shoot a concentrated lump of soil. This will cause blunt trauma in the target.
Carriers of this gene can use the stored minerals to work with increased efficiency at the cost of draining minerals.

Carriers of this gene can inject a copy of their xenogerm into another person through a very disgusting injector stinger. This doesn't cause their genes to need to regrow, but the ability cannot be used constantly, needing to recharge. It will also damage its target, and cause a bloody mess.

Carriers of this gene can inject a copy of their xenogerm into another person through a very disgusting injector stinger. Instead of implanting their genes into the target, this will inject them with eggs that will slowly grow inside them. These eggs will eventually hatch into a newborn with the same xenogenes as their progenitor. The ability doesn't cause the user's genes to need to regrow, but the ability cannot be used constantly, needing to recharge. It will also damage its target, and cause a bloody mess. And the target will obviously die when the babies hatch. Ah, the circle of nature!

Carriers of this gene will age at a decreased rate. This applies to both children and adults. This has its advantages and disadvantages.

Carriers of this gene are adept at mining and can acquire larger amounts of minerals from stone.
Carriers of this gene are shoddy miners and can produce fewer amounts of minerals from stone.
Carriers of this gene have archites in the blood which will sustain their metabolism without needing to consume food.
Carriers of this gene have no emotions.

Carriers of this gene will periodically generate small clumps of organic matter on their backs that gradually develop into full human beings, and separate from their host / parent via a process of strobilation. This will provide an endless source of new colonists, at the risk of flooding the colony with newborns.
Carriers of this gene have a distributed network of specialized mechanites on their bloodstream that periodically tend to internal wounds, regenerating them without any need for rest.
Carriers of this gene are almost unaffected by heat. They will also not be bothered by flames, and they can't catch on fire.
Carriers of this gene are almost unaffected by cold. They will be simultaneously not bothered by frostbite.
Carriers of this gene can completely change their very own personality, getting rid of old traits and gaining new ones.
Carriers of this gene have strengthened fungal structures that confer unbelievable stregth and they are incredibly dangerous on close quarters combat.
Carriers of this gene move at an increased speed as their infection progresses. The effects increase in severity with time.

Carriers of this gene have a special connection to the ocular trees, allowing them to act as an amplifier to the special properties of the tree, giving them access to powerful innate psychic abilities.

Carriers of this gene have several fungal clumps sprouting from their skin. These fungi cause them no pain and provide a considerable amount of natural armor, at the cost of making them VERY vulnerable to fire.
Carriers of this gene have very frail and thin skin. This confers a small increase to damage received.
Hard, wood-like skin. This confers a small amount of natural armour.
Carriers of this gene have their skin strengthened by a nano-lattice of metallic compounds. This confers a medium amount of natural armour.
Carriers of this gene have their skin strengthened by a plasteel nano-lattice. This confers a great amount of natural armour.
Carriers of this gene have four functional toughspike claws growing from their back that they can use in melee attacks.
Carriers of this gene have two fleshy, muscled tentacles with blades at the end. These flesh whips make for excellent melee weapons.
Carriers of this gene are so unfathomably ugly and grotesque that merely looking at them is enough to make other people nauseous.
Carriers of this gene possess an unnatural, almost pristine beauty that makes them stand out among others of their kind.
Going beyond mundane notions of beauty or ugliness, the carrier of this gene has such an unsettling appearance that it inspires a certain sense of unease on other people.
The carrier of this gene has an appearance that terrifies other people to the very core of their being. They will always be despised.
The carrier of this gene doesn't care about ugliness, feeling equally attracted to ugly colonists. Beauty is in the eye of the beholder after all (the person looking, not the D&D monster).
Carriers of this gene have a chemfuel powered metabolism, and as such will bleed chemfuel instead of normal human blood. This blood is flammable.
Carriers of this gene have slimy, green coloured blood. This blood is thick, exceptionally ugly, and doesn't go away on its own.
Carriers of this gene have extremely acidic blood. This blood doesn't harm them, but it will spill everywhere when they are slain, hurting all people nearby.
Carriers of this gene have very thick, dark and sticky blood, similar to tar. This blood impedes movement.
Carriers of this gene have insect blood.
Carriers of this gene have a weird fire retardant mixture for blood. This blood is not potent enough to put down fires, but it will not let flames spread.

Carriers of this gene have partially crystallized blood, that takes the form of small stone-like pebbles as soon as it comes into contact with air. This blood affects much less the beauty and cleanliness of its surroundings, but takes more time to go away and more work to clean.
Carriers of this gene have watered down blood. Their blood is so thin that puddles of it will be virtually indistinguishable from water.

Carriers of this gene have a cryogenic fluid for blood. This liquid will quickly drop the temperature of its surroundings, making it both useful and incredibly dangerous. Dissipates faster than normal blood but can't be cleaned.
Carriers of this gene have yellow blood.

Carriers of this gene have a scaly appearance in their body, with bioluminescent spots.

Carriers of this gene have digitigrade legs, meaning they stand or walk with their toes (metatarsals) touching the ground, and the rest of their foot lifted.

No, no, you misunderstand: these are biological, DNA codified chainsaw hands. Children of two people with chainsaw hands will have itty bitty chainsaw hands. It's science.

Carriers of this gene have a strain of virulent fungi that has braided itself into sickly looking tentacles that constantly twitch and move.

Techno-organic coils of wireless energy are wired into the carrier's genome, allowing them to recharge batteries nearby.
The carrier of this gene possesses a tube-like organ within the body. It allows humans to produce low quantities of insect jelly over time.
The carrier of this gene constantly pollutes the surrounding terrain, eventually turning the landscape into a desolate wasteland.

A distributed cloud of mechanites is interwoven with the DNA of the carrier. These mechanites have the ability of warping space via a psychic pinhole, causing an extradimensional red fog to coalesce around the carrier.

A distributed cloud of mechanites is interwoven with the DNA of the carrier. These mechanites have the ability of attracting the ashy cinders of close volcanoees, causing volcanic ash to fall, sometimes along with rain.

A distributed cloud of mechanites is interwoven with the DNA of the carrier. These mechanites have the ability of drastically lowering the atmospheric pressure around and increasing acidity of the rain, causing constant acidic rain precipitation.
A distributed cloud of mechanites is interwoven with the DNA of the carrier. These mechanites have the ability of almost completely covering the sun, causing constant forsaken night weathers.
The carrier of this gene constantly exudes and produces globs of royal jelly, which provides some extra food for the colony.
Carriers of this gene have a very weak stomach and will suffer more often from food poisoning.

Carriers of this gene constantly secrete a foul-smelling, corrosive gas that produces an uncomfortable, itchy sensation in living beings. This gas is mostly harmless, unless it comes into contact with decaying organic matter: it greatly accelerates corpse rotting, liberating a black putrid liquid known as "purge fluid" or corpse bile. The carrier is fed through the skin by contacting the liquid sludge, although they can also feed on other organic matter if needed.

Carriers of this gene have chlorophyll pigments in their skin that allows them to absorb nutrients from sunlight, eliminating almost entirely their need to eat, but requiring them to be constantly exposed to light for sustenance.
Carriers of this gene have strong, capable teeth, and they have little difficulty tearing into hard to chew foods.
Carriers of this gene have very weak, underdeveloped teeth, finding eating to be a chore.
Carriers of this gene have a strong survival instinct, intuitively knowing where to find the best forage and living off the land.
Carriers of this gene have a weak survival instinct, feeling quite out of their element when having to forage for food.
Carriers of this gene have developed a GIGANTIC mental fortitude and are capable of withstanding the greatest torture of all time: eating without a table.
Carriers of this gene have genetic knowledge related to Forsaken techniques and equipment. They will be able to build Forsaken structures and wear Forsaken apparel and armors.
Carriers of this gene have a yellow emblem associated with the forsaken on their midsection. This comes with multiple physical benefits.
Carriers of this gene have a yellow emblem associated with the forsaken on their forehead. This comes with multiple mental benefits.
Carriers of this gene will enjoy an extraordinary lifespan. Children will however take an incredibly long time to grow up.
Carriers of this gene feel completely at home in the Forsaken Crags, and will be immune to the oppressive feelings of the preternatural darkness.
Carriers of this gene attract rats, and a tame horde of these critters is constantly surrounding them.
Carriers of this gene have a mystical psychic bond with a wolf.
Carriers of this gene have a very strange interest in the politics of Old Earth, and polar bears. You'd think the overlap of those two things would be zero, but here we are.
The carrier of this gene will periodically exhale clouds of dense smoke, providing a deterrent to ranged attacks, both against them and produced by them.
The carrier of this gene will periodically exhale clouds of rot stink. Nasty!
The carrier of this gene will periodically exhale clouds of tox gas.
The carrier of this gene will periodically exhale clouds of deadlife dust that will raise nearby corpses as shamblers.
Carriers of this gene are always biologically male.
Carriers of this gene are always biologically female.
Carriers of this gene grow two large antennae protruding from the nose.

This person will explode on death, liberating a small amount of fleshbeasts.
The exhilaration caused after absorbing a fleshbeast is causing this person to have increased pain tolerance and strength. This will last for about a day.
A jointed appendage of an insectoid, consisting of several chitin covered segments. Whilst it’s an extremely painful mutation, this leg has much higher resistance to damage.
A jointed appendage of an insectoid, consisting of several chitin covered segments. Whilst it’s an extremely painful mutation, this arm has much higher resistance to damage.

An eye consisting of thousands of individual photoreceptor units, compound eyes have a large field of view and help with detecting fast movement, however its visibility range is significantly reduced. Whilst it’s an extremely painful mutation, this eye has a higher resistance to damage.

A pair of appendages situated on the sides of the mouth, Helping to crush and cut the food. Whilst it’s significantly less comfortable than normal jaw, insectoid mandibles significantly increase eating speed.

A sack-like gland tucked under the tongue that secretes acid, liquifying and allowing to safely consume even the most dangerous foods. The overstimulation of this gland enables the user to throw a short range acid spitting attack, effective at going through armor.
A powerful pneumatic pincer arm, capable of repeatedly exerting great pressure on the target at the cost of refined motor skills.
An insectoid kidney with a hyperactive adrenal gland. Subjects with this mutation may find newfound pleasure in inflicting pain. However, it does bring the side effect of unwarranted aggression.

A slender, mobile sensory organ that serves to compliment vision and locational awareness. A subject with this mutation will no longer suffer from darkness penalties, however sensory overload makes it very difficult to socialize.
A highly efficient, although basic stomach alternative. Subjects with this mutation will be able to live longer with less food. Increases nutrition of non-raw food by 10%.
Insectoid glands that slowly leak colorless, odorless, but sticky pheromone, notable for inducing a mild euphoria in those nearby.

A barely understood heart and artery mutation, causes blood to coagulate into oxygen-rich gel-like material. Upon laceration or even loss of limbs, the gel will cauterize the wound immediately. Unfortunately puts heavy strain on human cardiovascular biology.

An insectoid brain particularly sensitive to residual psychic synapse. A creature with this mutation possesses profound collective thought and psychic sensitivity, however is barely able to form cohesive sentences.
This person has an increased range when commanding drafted mechanoids.
This person has a decreased range when commanding drafted mechanoids.
This mechanoid's capacities have been boosted by a mechanitor with genetically enhanced mech repair capabilities.
Due to a lack of minerals, this person's body can no longer sustain their metabolism. Their hunger is insatiable
Their minerals are hardening their skin against attacks by how strong their mineral reserves are.
Their mineral reserves are being rapidly consumed to work at break neck pace!
Limited flight that allows this colonist to hop and glide small distances over terrain. They will ignore terrain movement costs when moving.
This person moves without movement penalties through water. They will ignore terrain movement costs when moving through watery terrains.
Limited flight that allows this colonist to hover over terrain. They will ignore terrain movement costs when moving. The hydrogen inside the gas bags will cause this person to blow up when killed.
This person has been affected by a speed burst, making it move faster for a while. Effects will go away after 1 hour.

Will periodically generate small clumps of organic matter on their backs that gradually develop into full human beings, and separate from their host / parent via a process of strobilation. This will provide an endless source of new colonists, at the risk of flooding the colony with newborns.
Females with this gene will periodically lay eggs when fertilized.

Affected by parasitic implantation. If the implantation advances to severity 1, or if the creature dies when it is sufficiently advanced (more than 90%), the human larvae inside the parasitic eggs will devour the victim from inside and hatch from its corpse. Gestation time is 15 days.
The skin of this person constantly exudes and produces globs of insect jelly, which provides some extra food for the colony.
This person has psychically shift their skin tones to camouflage in almost any surroundings.
This person is completely blind... until they gain psychic powers. They can direct their inner psychic sight and gain even better insight the more power they acquire.

This person has psychic powers that depend on their mood. With low moods, and thus higher break risk, they'll have psychic bonuses. With a Catharsis, these bonuses will be even higher (even if the mood is increased during Catharsis).
This person will be knocked unconscious under direct sunlight.
This person's eyes will hurt slightly under direct sunlight.
This person will quickly burn to death under direct sunlight.
Generates intense heat up to 80ºC. Bear in mind this condition itself doesn't make the carrier heat resistant.
Generates intense cold up to -20ºC. Bear in mind this condition itself doesn't make the carrier cold resistant.
Moves fast at high temperatures, at the cost of getting much more tired.
This person has increased manipulation and manual dexterity.
This person has increased movement and working speed.
This person has a huge boost to their immune system, and overall stamina.
There are no words to describe how revolting this person is.
This person emanates an aura of preternatural beauty.
Being close to this person causes a soothing feeling.
The skin of this person constantly exudes and produces globs of royal jelly, which provides some extra food for the colony.

A distributed cloud of mechanites is interwoven with the DNA of this person. These mechanites have the ability of influencing the humidity levels of the surrounding atmosphere, causing a deep, thick fog to coalesce around.
A distributed cloud of mechanites is interwoven with the DNA of this person. These mechanites have the ability of drastically lowering the atmospheric pressure around, causing constant precipitation.

A distributed cloud of mechanites is interwoven with the DNA of this person. These mechanites have the ability of drastically lowering the atmospheric pressure around, causing constant precipitation and a deep, thick fog to coalesce.

A distributed cloud of mechanites is interwoven with the DNA of this person. These mechanites have the ability of drastically increasing electrostatic energy and lowering atmospheric pressure, causing a violent rainy thunderstorm to form.

A distributed cloud of mechanites is interwoven with the DNA of this person. These mechanites have the ability of drastically increasing electrostatic energy in the atmosphere, causing a violent dry thunderstorm to form. This does not make the carrier immune to lightning strikes!
A distributed cloud of mechanites is interwoven with the DNA of this person. These mechanites have the ability of drastically lowering temperature in the upper atmosphere, causing snow to fall.

Rough concrete. Broken due to lack of maintenance.
An unnatural gray floor. It is featureless and smooth. It is not concrete, metal, or any other recognizable building material.
This Forsaken-style hood gives protection, while helping the wearer keep calm and focused.
This Forsaken-style hood gives protection, while helping the wearer keep calm and focused.
This cloak has been fabricated by Forsaken for all of their hunting needs.
This cloak has been fabricated by Forsaken for all of their hunting needs.
An ultratech Forsaken helmet designed for combat. Extremely durable and heightens focus.
An ultratech Forsaken helmet designed for combat. Extremely durable and heightens focus. This particular design enhances psycic sensitivity instead of suppressing it.
An ultratech Forsaken armor designed for combat. Extremely durable and comfortable.
An impassable gray wall. Capable of holding up a roof.
Divides rooms. Simple doors must be manually opened, which slows people down. The amount of slowdown depends on what the door is made of.
A strange, twisted sculpture shaped into a disturbing form. It hums gently with some strange internal energy.
A crude sketch drawn onto the ground.
A smooth-sided hole that extends endlessly downwards.
A smooth-sided hole that extends endlessly downwards.
A smooth-sided hole that extends endlessly downwards.
An empty, strange gray container. It is featureless and the surfaces are smooth. The material is not metal, concrete, or any other identifiable material.
A workbench for creating implantable xenogerms from genepacks stored in nearby gene banks. This device has collapsed in on itself, rendering it useless.

This device was able to store genepacks and make them usable to create new xenogerms, when placed near a gene assembler. It has corroded beyond any repair, and the genepacks stored inside are far gone.
An automated surgery machine that was able to extract a person's genes and create a genepack from them. Its internal machinery is completely fused and rusted.
A genetic analysis and processing system. Ruined and unuseable.
A vat of fluid which was able to gestate an embryo or accelerate a child's growth. Its transparent plasteel sheel has been smashed open, seemingly from the inside... Ominous.
A huge gene bank, much larger than the ones in use nowadays. Completely broken.
A broken vitals monitor with a dead screen.
A broken mechanoid-band signal amplifier. Its antennas are bent in weird angles.
A broken mech recharger. The connecting pins are bent and chipped, making the whole machine useless.
A broken mech recharger. The connecting pins are bent and chipped, making the whole machine useless.
A tank used to create new mechanoids. The mechanite tank was punctured long ago, and all the fluid has long since evaporated.
A tank used to create new mechanoids. The mechanite tank was punctured long ago, and all the fluid has long since evaporated.
This thing is SO edgy. Like, SUPER edgy. Basically a medical bed with spikes. I bet it only worked if you played symphonic metal in the background. I blame Oskar.
This was just a fancy waste bin, and it is now just a broken waste bin.
A bed specially designed for use in hospitals. The mattress has rotted away into nothingness.
A rusted triple-stack shelf. It doesn't hold as many items as it once had, due to its state of disrepair.
This pump isn't going to pump anything at all anytime soon.
This skeleton has seen better days.
A metallic capsule filled with some bioluminescent compound. This one seems to still be producing some faint light.
A metallic post with a glass cilinder filled with some bioluminescent compound. This one seems to still be producing some faint light.
This device seems to be emitting weak radio waves.

A temporary mechanoid-band signal amplifier. Automatically tuned to the mechanitor that summoned it. It will provide a significant 10 bandwidth boost, but it will vanish after a week. Doesn't require power.
A luminescent column made of coral.
A luminescent column made of coral.
It seems to be chilling out.
An electric-powered forge for smithing forsaken weapons and tools. Can only be built by a colonist with the Forsaken Knowledge gene.
An impassable wall. Capable of holding up a roof.
An impassable wall. Capable of holding up a roof.
Divides rooms. Simple doors must be manually opened, which slows people down. The amount of slowdown depends on what the door is made of.

A small capsule containing a package of genetic information. To use a genepack, it must be placed in a gene bank near a gene assembler and combined into an implantable xenogerm.

If not kept in a powered gene bank, this genepack will slowly deteriorate.

Alphapacks only contain combinations of Alpha genes.

A small capsule containing a package of genetic information. To use a genepack, it must be placed in a gene bank near a gene assembler and combined into an implantable xenogerm.

If not kept in a powered gene bank, this genepack will slowly deteriorate.

Mixedpacks contain combinations of Alpha genes and standard genes.

A genetic toolkit capable of removing a random gene from a human target. This removal is quite destructive, and will target a gene at random. As a result, the target will drop into a coma for 3 days. Using the remover on a colonist suffering from the coma will have no effect.

A genetic toolkit capable of converting a random xenogene from a human target into an endogene. As a result, the target will drop into a coma for 3 days. Using the endogenefier on a colonist suffering from the coma will have no effect.

A genetic toolkit capable of converting a random endogene from a human target into a xenogene. As a result, the target will drop into a coma for 3 days. Using the xenogenefier on a colonist suffering from the coma will have no effect.

A genetic toolkit capable of forcefully removing all xenotype genes from the target, reverting them to baseline humanity. As a result, the target will drop into a coma for 3 days. Using the nullifier on a colonist suffering from the coma will have no effect.

A genetic toolkit capable of forcefully removing all genes from the target, both germline and xenogenes, and replacing them with a random xenotype. As a result, the target will drop into a coma for 3 days. Using the injector on a colonist suffering from the coma will have no effect.

A genetic toolkit capable of causing random genetic mutations on the subject's germline, producing one random endogene. As a result, the target will drop into a coma for 3 days. Using the mutator on a colonist suffering from the coma will have no effect.

A genetic toolkit capable of acting upon an existing genepack, alphapack or mixedpack, adding a new, random gene to it. The targetted genepack must have 3 or less genes inside it, and this process won't add new archite genes to it.
A genetic toolkit capable of acting upon an existing genepack, alphapack or mixedpack, deleting a random gene present on it. The targetted genepack must have 2 or more genes inside it.

A genetic toolkit capable of removing a specific gene from a human target. This removal is quite destructive, and as a result, the target will drop into a coma for 3 days. Using the remover on a colonist suffering from the coma will have no effect.

A genetic toolkit capable of converting a specific xenogene from a human target into an endogene. As a result, the target will drop into a coma for 3 days. Using the archotech endogenefier on a colonist suffering from the coma will have no effect.

A genetic toolkit capable of converting a specific endogene from a human target into a xenogene. As a result, the target will drop into a coma for 3 days. Using the archotech xenogenefier on a colonist suffering from the coma will have no effect.
Fertilized human egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a human. Must be kept between 0 and 50 ºC.
Ultima fabric is used in the making of Forsaken armors. Produced by septimum plant, which can only be sown by colonists with the Forsaken Knowledge gene.
A large, mutated scorpion. A multitude of twitching eyes look around nervously.
A mid-size crop that yields ultima fibers. The fibers are used in the making of forsaken armor. Only colonists with the Forsaken Knowledge gene will be able to sow this plant.

A beautiful alien plant. Often used by Forsaken as a light source. It is ill advised to eat this, as it is extremely toxic. Only colonists with the Forsaken Knowledge gene will be able to sow this plant.

A beautiful alien plant. Often used by Forsaken as a darklight source. It is ill advised to eat this, as it is extremely toxic. Only colonists with the Forsaken Knowledge gene will be able to sow this plant.
This sniper rifle is prized by Forsaken explorers for its long range and high accuracy.
Forsaken shotgun, great accuracy at short distances and very deadly at close range.
This Forsaken assault rifle has a rather small calibre cartridge and a long reload time, but has a high burst shot count, high armor penetration and decent accuracy.
This Forsaken long sword takes little effort to lift and swing but can deal substantial damage.
The traditional Forsaken battle axe deals a lot of damage on impact, at the cost of unwealdy shape and weight.
A Forsaken equivalent of the gladius, common sidearms among Forsaken infantry. Terrible armor penetration, but easy to handle.
A Forsaken spear. Deals great damage, but can be difficult to handle.
This traditional Forsaken bow is very accurate and can deal decent damage. Its sharp edges make it usable in melee combat.

The Forsaken Black Hydra is a special weapon system that draws lightning to the point of fire, due to an ionized electrocloud detonator. Legend says these weapons needed to contain the heart of a hydra to function.
I can't get it out of my mind. How can anyone be SO revolting and grotesque?
I can't get it out of my mind. How can anyone be SO beautiful?
I feel calm and at peace
The smell of putrid corpse bile and corpse-rotting gas is overpowering!
I can't stand being near water! It terrifies me.
No matter how many times it happens, I'll never get used to this.
I CAN FEEL THE EGGS MOVING INSIDE MY BODY!
The thrill of adventuring is exhilarating.
[PAWN_nameDef] possesses an unnatural, almost pristine beauty that makes [PAWN_objective] stand out among others of [PAWN_possessive] kind.
[PAWN_nameDef] is so unfathomably ugly and grotesque that merely looking at [PAWN_objective] is enough to make other people nauseous.

Fleetkind were a misguided attempt at creating a human xenotype capable of flourishing on their own, completely isolated from other external societies. A properly established fleetkind outpost can generate its own electricity and easily replenish its numbers.\n\nFleetkind deviate greatly from baseline humans, and they are often seen as too strange to interact with.
A misguided attempt at creating a human xenotype capable of flourishing on their own. They deviate greatly from baseline humans, and they are often seen as too strange to interact with.

The lowest of the low on the Rim, helixans were created as a human xenotype that would revel in the presence of decay, filth and refuse. Capable of exuding a foul-smelling, corrosive gas that produces an uncomfortable, itchy sensation in living beings. This gas is mostly harmless, unless it comes into contact with decaying organic matter: it greatly accelerates corpse rotting, liberating a black putrid liquid known as "purge fluid" or corpse bile. The helixans feed through the skin by contacting the liquid sludge, although they can also feed on other organic matter if needed.
Revolting slug-like humans that feed on corpses and decay.

Animusen were genetically spliced with Animus Vox genes to create a cold-thriving human xenotype with a much better -and less aggressive- disposition than Yttakin.\n\nAnimusen have strong psychic abilities, and they are very attuned to the feelings of others, often being valued as adept counsellors.
A cold-thriving human xenotype with a much better -and less aggressive- disposition than Yttakin, and powerful psychic abilities.

Where dirtmoles are unable to thrive due to inhospitable conditions, the lapis excel. Created by ultra-greedy corporations eager to wring the very last resources out of desolate, mineral rich planets, the lapis are a xenotype adapted to living basically without organic food, but at a hefty cost: they must continually search for minerals to feed themselves and sustain their strange metabolism. Lapis are practical and brusque, preferring to keep to themselves in most cases.

A xenotype of rocky looking humans adapted to living basically without organic food, but at a hefty cost: they must continually search for minerals to feed themselves and sustain their strange metabolism.

A testament to the horrible dangers of genetic engineering, wretches are malformed and miserable creatures produced by genetic testing gone awry. The genome of wretches is so twisted and unstable that constant, wild mutations occur every day, being erased and replaced the following morning. These mutations can be hugely beneficial, or they can condemn the wretch to a short life of misery and pain.
Malformed and miserable creatures produced by genetic testing gone awry. Subject to daily unstable mutations that can rewrite their genome completely.

Named after the ancient Lithuanian word for "grease", the taukai are a very strange human xenotype, created to withstand extremely radioactive environments. The flesh of the taukai is slimy, looking like molten wax, and full of physical abnormalities, deformities and tumors. Their tissues are constantly regenerating and morphing, causing the formation of dangerous carcinomas. They have however an extraordinary ability to order their bodies to repurpose these carcinomas and use them for several beneficial designs.
A xenotype of constantly morphing, cancerous afflicted people. They constantly get carcinomas and can repurpose them to get powerful buffs.

The result of an escaped experiment of the Sophian Empire, hivelings are barely human, thoroughly infused as they are with insectoid organs and genetic advantages. Hivelings thrive in heavily polluted environments, being strengthened by them. They are completely sterile, reproducing by implanting their parasitic eggs in still-living prisoners, and evolving their hive by acquiring new genes from them.\n\nHivelings are usually reviled by other human xenotypes.
Barely human, insectoid-like mutants that reproduce via parasitic infestation.

A xenotype inspired by the old eldritch folklore tales from old Earth, the Chthonian visage of mind devourers inspires terror and intense uneasiness. They are masters of the psychic arts, being capable of projecting their mental powers and using their mind as a fearsome weapon, as well as devouring the brains of their victims and extracting valuable knowledge from them.\n\nMind devourers are usually reviled by other human xenotypes.
A xenotype of powerful brain devouring psychics that are reviled by any other humans around the Rim.

A modified strain of the impid xenotype designed as terrifying shock troopers, efreet were created to be as intimidating as possible. Whereas impids are adept at fire-based, ranged combat, Efreet are perfectly capable of ripping their enemies to shreds in close quarters combat with their fearsome claws. Efreet possess incredible heat resistant capabilities, and are immune to fire, being almost obssessed with it.
A modified strain of the impid xenotype designed as shock troopers. Obsessed with fire and almost immune to heat.

An attempt to create a xenotype of beautiful, harmless and subservient people, during the final synthesis of the genes one of the involved scientists failed to notice that his pet bearded lizard had shed its skin inside of the vat. Upon the first official synthesis, the subject demonstrated impeccable strength and perception, while retaining their otherworldly beauty. Essentially she was as likely to embrace you as much as she would eat your face.
A xenotype of beautiful draconic people. Usually underestimated by their enemies, as their physical appearance makes them seem less threatening that they really are.

Originally created as a xenotype adapted to living in shallow waters, Nereids evolved to thrive in the ocean's abyss. They have large, luminescent eyes, fin-like ears, and webbed hands and feet for efficient swimming, as well as bioluminescent markings on their skin that aid in communication and camouflage.\n\nNereids have a unique ability to access a personal pocket plane, an ocean abyss-themed dimension they can retreat to or use for strategic advantage. It serves as a sanctuary, a place of learning, and a tactical refuge, allowing Nereids to evade threats or ambush predators.

A xenotype evolved to thrive in the ocean's abyss. They have large, luminescent eyes, fin-like ears, and webbed hands and feet for efficient swimming, Nereids have a unique ability to access a personal pocket plane, an ocean abyss-themed dimension they can retreat to or use for strategic advantage.

The legacy of a fallen empire, with a distant and tenuous link to the original genelines of Earth. Other than the fact that they began to awaken over the past century and that they terraformed forsaken crags onto some rimworlds at some point in the past, no one knows much else about what they are, where they are from or fundamentals behind their technology, which seems to bridge the gap between science and magic.
A distant relative of the original genelines of Earth. There is very little known about them.
This will transform the xenotype of the pawn into one of the custom xenotypes created by the player at random.
This will transform the xenotype of the pawn into one of the custom xenotypes created by the player at random.

The result of ancient victims of the fungoid military bioweapons project, mycomorphs have been subjected to a specially virulent strain of the virus, which causes their bodies to rot and become infused with extense mycelial networks. Mycomorphs constantly secrete a foul smelling gas and have a similarly rotten disposition, tending to act aggressively towards others. A controlled mycomorph can be a huge combat asset, or a dangerous potential threat to the rest of the colony.

Victims of a more virulent strain of the fungoid virus. Violent, very dangerous, both to other mycomorphs but specially to other xenotypes around them, as they can infect them via melee attacks, and they love to fight others.

Based on genetic data retrofitted from Gauranlen Inc.’s investment into dendrology following the Fall of Sorne, phytokins are plant-based humanoids with an emphasis on symmetry and symbiosis. Their ability to subsist only on sunlight and affinity with any and all plantlife make them especially suited to aiding newly established colonies or underperforming industrial farms.

Based on research from the forest planet of Phytok that committed to extensive analysis on human-compatibility with psychic energy, phytokin xenogerms are typically exclusive to high-ranking, supporting roles in megacorporations and planetary governments. Their unique way of reproduction has resulted in many identical offspring, with each generation becoming successively more competent than their progenitor, further contributing to their extremely low numbers. Their affinity with plantlife, along with the side effect of extremely high and ever-increasing psychic sensitivity, mean that any phytokin xenohumans found on the Rim are always adapted to high-concept, dominant trees that are present on their residing planet.

This particular xenogerm has adapted itself to Ocular trees, a strange breed of alien-looking trees native to a poorly understood extradimensional realm of pure madness.

Individualistic and bizarre, ocularkins are warped and cunning and possess an ability to connect with ocular trees. They are excellent at taking care of plants and reproduce via planting a saplingchild.

The Malachai are a race of truly monstrous beings that have evolved from Strigoi. They possess the same thirst for blood as their Strigoi predecessors, but have also learned to incorporate the genetic material of their prey to enhance their own abilities. With their DNA extraction abilities, they can absorb traits such as heightened senses, increased speed, and advanced technological skills, making them an incredibly powerful force.

However, their abilities and thirst for power come at a cost, and Malachai are often twisted and cruel in their actions towards others. They harbour a deep-seated hatred for other sanguophages, and will only collaborate with them out of abject necessity. As adept schemers, the Malachai always have an ulterior motive or agenda bubbling beneath the surface of their superficial actions.

Their society is highly hierarchical and ruthless, with powerful Malachai ruling over weaker ones through fear and intimidation. They are feared by many and considered a dangerous threat to be avoided whenever possible.

Malachai are mutated Strigoi: ageless, deathless super-humans powered by archotech-created archites in the bloodstream. They can slowly incorporate genes from their enemies. They can heal any injury, and never suffer from disease or poison. In combat, they use their huge talons to rip their prey to pieces. The price is that they must consume hemogen derived from humans to survive, and they must periodically deathrest for long periods. They lose their hemogen supply and need to replenish it regularly to sustain themselves. They're easily destroyed by fire, and suffer truly extreme penalties in UV light.

By default, the three "unstable mutations" genes will display a pop up message telling you which genes have been acquired by each colonist. This is fine if you have one colonist, not so fine if you have 20... With this options toggle you can remove those messages.

By default, every time a pawn with the thalassophobia gene flees from water the game will generate a letter informing the player. This may be a bit too much if you have many pawns fleeing often, so you can disable it with this toggle. Bear in mind the pawns will still flee, you'll just NOT get informed.
Genetic tools cause gene removal coma
Using any genetic tool causes a gene removal coma that lasts for 3 days, knocking the colonist out, and no other tool can be used in that period. This is ON by default for balance.

Disables Abandoned Biotech Lab quests from triggering. Bear in mind these quests are independent of any other quests or storyteller events (raids, manhunters, etc). WARNING: disabling this will make most alpha genes and genetic tools unobtainable during normal gameplay.
Abandoned Biotech Labs multiplier (lower means getting the event more often)

The frequency of the Abandoned Biotech Lab quest being offered is multiplied by this number (with a multiplier of 1, it is offered every between 15 and 30 days at random). Numbers below 1 decrease the time, while numbers above it increase it. Note that this event doesn't "replace" normal quests, it works independently.
Show ALL animal summon genes (requires game reload)

If selected, ALL animal summon genes will be shown on the xenotype creator screen. Bear in mind these genes will draw from all animals, vanilla or modded, so this can get out of control fast! By default, they are hidden, and three genes are shown that choose one of them at random.
Give random shambler-only genes to shamblers
If active, any shambler appearing on the map will get a bunch (1-3) of random shambler-only genes.
